business_summary: Jiangsu Zhongsheng Gaoke Environmental Co.,Ltd. provides environmental protection services in China. It is involved in soil remediation and investigation, environmental engineering, environmental assessment and consulting, wastewater operation, water conservancy projects, water treatment, and pipeline operation and maintenance. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Gaoke Petrochemical Co., Ltd and changed its name to Jiangsu Zhongsheng Gaoke Environmental Co.,Ltd. in June 2021. Jiangsu Zhongsheng Gaoke Environmental Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Suzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: 강소중성가오케환경유한회사 중국에서 환경 보호 서비스를 제공합니다. 토양 복원 및 조사, 환경 엔지니어링, 환경 평가 및 컨설팅, 폐수 운영, 물 보존 프로젝트, 수처리, 파이프라인 운영 및 유지 관리에 참여합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Jiangsu Gaoke Petrochemical Co., Ltd로 알려졌으며 이름을 Jiangsu Zhongsheng Gaoke Environmental Co., Ltd로 변경했습니다. 2021년 6월. Jiangsu Zhongsheng Gaoke Environmental Co.,Ltd. 1992년에 설립되었으며 중국 쑤저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
